items.script: My name is Kelsang. These manuscripts are liturgical objects that the community reads aloud on particular days, and every reading costs the folios a measurable amount. Perfect conservation means the community loses the practice that gave the objects their meaning, and unrestricted use means that in two centuries there is nothing to conserve. The compromise we reached is that facsimiles are read on ordinary occasions and the originals twice a year, which is a rate of loss we have chosen rather than one that has chosen us.

items.script: I am Leontine. A student cited the trolley case to settle a question about clinical triage, and the difficulty is not that the analogy is imperfect. It is that the case was constructed to isolate one variable by stripping away uncertainty, institutional context and repeated interaction, all of which are the substance of triage. Using it here does not simplify the problem; it deletes it. The case remains a superb instrument, and an instrument calibrated for one measurement gives confident readings when applied to another.

items.script: My name is Ulla. Our reference corpus is built from published prose, broadcast transcripts and parliamentary records, which is a defensible sample and is also overwhelmingly the language of people who were educated in a particular way. When a construction from another variety appears, our tools mark it as rare, and rare in our corpus becomes non standard in the grammar written from it, and non standard becomes an error in the classroom two steps later. Nobody in that chain did anything careless. The judgment was made when the sample was drawn, and everything after that was arithmetic.

The aria we all consider the emotional center of the second act was cut by the composer after three performances and restored by a conductor in nineteen twenty two, and audiences have known the opera in that form for a century. Arguing for the composer version means arguing that a hundred years of performance history counts for nothing, which is a strange position for anybody who believes opera is a living practice. Arguing for the restored version means the composer own judgment is the one voice we ignore.

items.script: My name is Wanjiru. The program I am proudest of gave forty families a small budget and a conversation about what they needed. Its cost per beneficiary is terrible. I have stopped trying to argue the number down and started asking donors what they think the number is for, which is a slower conversation and the only one worth having.

items.script: Decision makers are trained to weigh internal consistency, and a person who gives the same account four times in the same order is believed.

items.script: My name is Yusra. Decision makers are trained to weigh internal consistency, and a person who gives the same account four times in the same order is believed. Trauma does not store memory in that order, and a rehearsed false account is perfectly consistent by construction. So the test we apply systematically favours the prepared over the harmed. I do not have a better instrument to offer, and I think saying that honestly is more useful than defending the one we have as though it were adequate.

items.script: My name is Anselm. Our new translation is clearer, and a congregation that has said the older words for fifty years does not experience clarity as a gain. They know the old text by heart, which means they can pray it while thinking about something else, and that absent minded fluency is not a defect of religious language but very close to its purpose. Comprehension and familiarity are both real goods. I voted for the clearer text and I would not tell anybody they are wrong to grieve.

items.script: I am Beatrix. The claim as drafted covers any system that performs this function by any means, and the applicant has built one implementation. Granting it hands them everything in a space they have explored a corner of. Narrowing it to what they actually built rewards the disclosure and leaves obvious variations free, and it also means a competitor changes one component and takes the market from the party that did the work. Neither outcome is just, and the office has to choose one this afternoon.

items.script: I am Dagny. Our table prices this cover accurately, and pricing it accurately means the households most likely to claim pay the most, which is the same as saying that the people who most need the cover can least afford it. Insurance is not a moral instrument and I am not asking it to be one. I do want the people who quote our numbers in policy debates to notice that an actuarially fair price and an accessible one are different objects, and that choosing between them is not an actuarial question.
